learning_outcomes.text: Design executive decks that drive a decision
Architect a reusable template and master system
Tell data stories with annotated, focused visuals
Integrate and refresh linked data from Excel
Build advanced motion with Morph for explanation
Standardise a brand system across a team
Facilitate executive delivery and Q and A
Govern accessibility and version control at scale

integrative_case: A strategy lead must win board approval for a 50M investment. Architect a reusable executive template, build a data-story section with linked Excel charts that refresh, use Morph to explain a mechanism, prepare an appendix for Q and A, and enforce brand and accessibility standards across the team, then defend the decision narrative.
